name: jengo/storage
description: Unified multi-disk file management, cloud storage abstraction (Local, S3, Cloudflare R2, Memory), chunked resumable uploads, temporary signed URL security, image manipulation pipelines (GD/Imagick), and testing doubles for CodeIgniter 4 and the Jengo Framework.

facade.description: Primary static entry point for file operations, multi-disk resolution, signed URLs, image transforms, and test doubles.

methods.disk: Storage::disk(?string $name = null): FilesystemInterface (access specific disk or default)
methods.missing: Storage::missing(string $path): bool (checks if file is absent)
methods.put: Storage::put(string $path, string $contents, ?string $visibility = null): bool (writes file contents)
methods.delete: Storage::delete(string|array $paths): bool (deletes one or multiple files)
methods.size: Storage::size(string $path): int (returns file size in bytes)
methods.lastModified: Storage::lastModified(string $path): int (returns Unix timestamp of modification)
methods.files: Storage::files(?string $directory = null, bool $recursive = false): array (lists files in directory)
methods.allFiles: Storage::allFiles(?string $directory = null): array (recursively lists all files)
methods.directories: Storage::directories(?string $directory = null, bool $recursive = false): array (lists subdirectories)
methods.deleteDirectory: Storage::deleteDirectory(string $directory): bool (deletes directory and all contents)
methods.temporaryUrl: Storage::temporaryUrl(string $path, int|DateTimeInterface $expiration, array $options = []): string (generates time-limited signed URL)
methods.createUploadUrl: Storage::createUploadUrl(string $path, array $options = []): PresignedUpload (generates presigned direct upload URL)
methods.fake: Storage::fake(string|array $diskNames = 'local'): StorageFake|array (swaps disks with in-memory test doubles)

drivers.name: local
drivers.description: Local filesystem driver storing files in writable/ directory with configurable permissions and public symlink integration.

drivers.name: s3
drivers.description: Amazon S3 and S3-compatible cloud storage driver supporting AWS, Cloudflare R2, MinIO, and Wasabi with direct multipart presigned uploads.

drivers.name: memory
drivers.description: In-memory filesystem driver for rapid zero-I/O testing and isolated environments.

image_processing.description: Fluent image transformation pipeline supporting resizing, cropping, fitting, format conversion, and quality compression.
methods: format(string $format): self (jpeg, png, webp, gif, avif)
save(?string $path = null): string (saves transformed image back to disk)
encode(): string (returns raw binary image data)

routes: GET /storage/signed/{path} (serves HMAC-signed private files with expiration validation)
POST /storage/upload/chunk (accepts multipart binary chunks for resumable large uploads)
POST /storage/upload/complete (assembles chunks and verifies checksum upon completion)

helpers.name: storage
helpers.description: Retrieve the storage manager or a specific disk instance.

helpers.name: storage_url
helpers.description: Get the public URL for a stored file.

helpers.name: storage_temporary_url
helpers.description: Generate a temporary signed URL for private file access.

commands.name: storage:link
commands.description: Create a symbolic link from public/storage to writable/storage/app/public.

commands.name: storage:cleanup
commands.description: Purge expired signed upload chunks and temporary files.

installers.description: Publishes app/Config/Storage.php and configures public storage symlink.
